title: Claude for Small Business launches new workflows, integrations, and training programs
summary: Claude for Small Business now includes 43 workflows and 27 new integrations (Shopify, Salesforce, Gusto), enabling automation of lead generation, proposal writing, financial reconciliation, and content planning. The company is launching a fall tour with free workshops and partner webinars across 10 US cities.

title: How healthcare organizations use Claude Tag
summary: Claude Tag is a Slack-integrated AI agent enabling healthcare organizations to automate alert triage, internal tool maintenance, and compliance workflows with per-channel PHI restrictions. Insight Health achieved 97% automation of alert triage using Claude Tag, and enterprises linking it to GitHub receive $25,000 in credits through October 1, 2026.

title: Building an AI-native revenue organization
summary: Anthropic released an eBook guide for revenue leaders on deploying Claude across sales organizations, featuring a three-phase rollout plan, maturity models, and ROI measurement. Cox Communications case study shows 7x first-year ROI and 86% cost reduction in lead validation.

title: Deploying AI from pilot to production
summary: Anthropic and Accenture released a guide for deploying AI initiatives from pilot to production, providing a four-part job definition framework and four-tier oversight model (automated, sampled, reviewed, advisory). The guide addresses the fact that only 23% of C-suite leaders report sustained enterprise-wide AI impact.

title: Claude for Financial Advisors
summary: Claude for Financial Advisors integrates with 11 major platforms (Addepar, Charles Schwab, Vanguard, etc.) and provides 8 specialized skills for pre-meeting prep, portfolio reviews, compliance screening, and admin tasks. Built-in safeguards require advisor approval on key decisions. The tool aims to free advisors to focus on client service by automating administrative burden that currently limits face-time to 1/6 of their day.

title: Agentic coding is straining CI. Here's how we scaled test impact analysis at Anthropic
summary: Agentic coding at Anthropic triggered a 25x increase in CI jobs over six months, with Claude authoring 80% of shipped code but test volume growing 10x. Traditional scaling approaches proved insufficient; Anthropic redesigned with a distributed, stateless architecture using in-memory data stores. The company argues this horizontally scalable approach will become the industry standard as agentic coding drives exponential growth.
